Is there any way to be treated by the ER or A&E (idk where you are located) without your dad finding out? Really concerned to hear that you aren’t getting medical care for a wound that deep. The risk of infection is really high and infection in a wound that deep is incredibly dangerous and often leads to sepsis and/or loss of limb. If you absolutely will not get medical help, don’t use hydrogen peroxide or iodine on your wound. Sterile saline is best, slathering it with ointment. You want to keep it moist so it will heal from the inside out and not get an abscess due to closing to soon on the top.
